findings.finding: Transformer copper loss is 4.7x the designer's figure: the 0.10 mm litz (1550 strands) in a non-interleaved 11:12 winding of 56 mm breadth has F_r = 2.53 at 100 kHz (Sullivan; Bessel-strand model agrees), not the assumed 1.15, and the proximity factor grows with h^2 for the 3rd-9th current harmonics
findings.evidence: own: 338 W at 800/873 V 60 kW (designer 72.0 W), 407 W at the I1_rms_max point (designer max total 159 W); effective R_ac/R_dc 6.2 and 3.8; OpenMagnetics 236 W / 282 W at the same points; GMB reference transformer R_w = 78 mOhm at 100 kHz (UG p.52) implies ~440 W copper at 60 kW
findings.recommendation: Redesign the winding before the RFQ: strands <= 0.05 mm (proximity loss ~ d^2: /4) AND P-S-P interleaving (peak field /2: /4) or a core with ~2x the window breadth; then re-derive leakage (interleaving lowers it, the external inductor takes the rest) and feed F_r(h) from this model (sim/magnetics.py litz_loss) back into dab_design.py; re-check D-015/D-017 - part of the 2.5x calibration gap may be this

findings.finding: The 0.4 K/W hot-spot-to-coolant requirement is not credible for a PM 114/93 pot core: the winding is enclosed by ferrite (k ~4 W/mK) and its heat must cross the coil former and the core to the plate
findings.evidence: own conduction estimate 2.7 K/W (core base on the cold plate) and 0.71 K/W best case (potted Al housing touching skirt and winding through the slots): hot spot 163 C with the designer's 159 W, 354 C with the own 426 W, limit 130.0 C (class F 155 C)
findings.recommendation: Change the construction, not only the vendor requirement: E/U cores with open windows (e.g. 2 x E80 class, DMEGC EE80 DMR95 is filed) or a matrix of smaller cores, Al heat-spreader plates between winding sections, vacuum-potted into an Al housing; make the RFQ demand a measured Rth and a thermal run at the full-load loss

findings.where: sim/dab_devices.py FERRITE['N95'] (R34-toroid data used for a 1.9 kg core)
findings.finding: Core loss uses the small-toroid material curve; TDK's own limit for the PM 114/93 N95 set is 3.1x higher
findings.evidence: PM114-93.pdf p.2: P_V < 9.0 W/set at 50 mT, 100 kHz, 100 C vs 2.9 W from the R34 curve; scaled to 950 V (0.126 T) the guaranteed limit is 102 W against 29 W typical
findings.recommendation: Carry the core-set limit (or a measured value) in the thermal budget; RFQ: measured core loss of the set at 0.126 T / 100 kHz / 100 C with the real waveform

findings.finding: Leakage target 4.38 uH rests on winding builds that do not fit the PM 114/93 former; the buildable winding gives 3.08 uH
findings.evidence: round litz needs 26.8 mm radial build vs 19.5 mm available; profiled litz fits (12.1 mm) and gives 3.08 uH (-30 %); the external inductor would need 3.42 uH, outside the 6.07 uH trim maximum
findings.recommendation: Fix the construction in the spec (barrier thickness / section spacing set to give the target, e.g. ~6 mm) or widen the external inductor range; the leakage is part of the power transfer (DAB-06)

findings.finding: Series-inductor loss far above the 11 W budget - OpenMagnetics 28 W, own 109-189 W: the 0.4 x A_N copper (143 mm2 per turn = 18164 strands of 0.1 mm) sits in the fringing field of the 8.6 mm of gaps (H_rms ~63 A/m per A)
findings.evidence: own: copper 96-175 W at max current (smeared-gap / near-gap field models); gap for 2.12 uH with fringing 8.6 mm in 4 gaps / 14.0 mm single (designer 9.2 mm, no fringing); core under-used: B 0.11 T at 275 A, gap volume 16 cm3 vs 3.2 cm3 needed at 0.25 T
findings.recommendation: Use 25-40 mm2 of <= 0.05 mm litz kept >= 3 gap lengths from the gaps, or an air-core / quasi-distributed-gap E or U core sized for ~0.25 T; a 4-gap pot-core centre post is not a catalogue part

findings.where: cell_spec.json inductor conductor ('Litz, 10.3 mm2 copper ..., insulation for 1.1 kV')
findings.finding: Round litz of 10.3 mm2 with 1.1 kV insulation does not fit the 8044E window
findings.evidence: bundle OD 5.6 mm, 9 turns/layer, 5 layers = 28.1 mm build vs 17.8 mm window width (19.81 mm minus 2 mm former)
findings.recommendation: Specify profiled (rectangular) litz ~2.4 x 7.2 mm, 2 layers x 19 turns, strand <= 0.1 mm (0.2 mm strands add 7 W)

findings.where: gen/port.py CMC160 description (CUSTOM CM choke spec)
findings.finding: CM-choke spec has no low-frequency CM-current or DM-flux requirement; with a high-mu nanocrystalline core the 150 Hz CM current of the transformerless PCS saturates it
findings.evidence: Yunlu N-C-635025 (63/50/25 mm), 3 t, mu 70000 at 10 kHz: L_cm 0.55 mH; i_cm 0.78 A rms (A_VCM_LF 50 V, A_C_PV_PE 16 uF) -> B 1.97 T (3.94 T at 2x C_PV); DM leakage flux 2.39 T at 160 A; Bsat 1.25 T
findings.recommendation: Add to the spec: i_cm >= 1 A rms at 150 Hz with B <= 0.5 Bsat, DM flux at rated current with the leakage, flat-mu grade (mu(10 kHz) <= 25 000) or more core; see spec_port_cm_choke.md for a reference design

findings.finding: Flux at the current limit stated on A_e; on A_min it is 335 mT (> the 320 mT design limit)
findings.evidence: Lp +7 %, 1.74 A, A_min 71 mm2: 335 mT; N97 Bsat 410 mT at 100 C, ~383 mT at 120 C (extrapolated)
findings.recommendation: Accept with the margin stated on A_min at 120 C (87 %) or reduce the peak-current limit 5 %; vendor to measure L(I) to 1.86 A at 120 C

findings.where: AUX-HV T1 insulation (aux_hv_spec.json transformer desc; report section 11)
findings.finding: Reinforced barrier at 1000 V DC working rests on TIW alone in an ETD 29 coil former; partial-discharge capability of TIW at this working voltage and the coil-former creepage pin-row -> core -> pin-row are not shown
findings.evidence: ECO-10 levels (sim/out/insulation): PD <= 10 pC at 2461 V pk, AC 4400 V rms, impulse 8000 V, creepage 10 mm PD2 / 6.4 mm potted, clearance 9.2 mm at 3000 m; TIW insulation is three thin extruded layers; ETD 29 pins sit a few mm from the core
findings.recommendation: Insulation coordination (ECO-10) to fix the levels; RFQ: TIW certificate for reinforced insulation at the working voltage, PD test (extinction above 1.5 x the recurring peak), creepage drawing of the former; potting or a larger former if short

findings.finding: A 3 mm barrier inside a single-section PM coil former at 1850 V DC working (basic) only works as solid insulation in a vacuum-potted part; creepage along the former between the windings cannot be met in air
findings.evidence: b_iso 3 mm (dab_design.py A['b_iso']); one-section former B65734B1000T001; ECO-10 levels: working 1850 V, PD <= 10 pC at 3149 V pk, AC 3323 V rms, creepage 20 mm PD2 / 7.5 mm potted
findings.recommendation: Specify vacuum potting / impregnation and a PD test at the coordinated level, or a two-section former with a creepage barrier; levels pending ECO-10

findings.where: sim/out/magnetics/design_dab_series_inductor.json rev M1 vs dab_spec.json series_inductor I_sat_min_A
findings.finding: The series-inductor saturation requirement moved from 275 A to 635 A (1.1 x the trip fault peak (DR-03, soft turn-off path) at 100 C) after rev M1: the 3-turn construction reaches 0.368 T = 0.90 B_sat (100 C, typical) - no saturation, but only ~10 % margin on a typical B_sat value
findings.evidence: B = L I / (N A_e) = 5.56 uH x 635 A / (3 x 3200 mm2); gapped ferrite: L falls < 10 % at 0.9 B_sat because the gap dominates the reluctance
findings.recommendation: 4 turns on the same 4 x EE80 (gap 11.9 mm in 8 gaps): B 0.276 T = 0.67 B_sat, loss 106 W worst (3 turns: 90 W), fits True; decide with the DAB cost round (rev M2), or accept 3 turns with a measured L(I) to 635 A at 100 C

findings.where: sim/out/magnetics/design_pv_inductor.json rev M2 on PV-P100/110 (sim/out/pv_design/module_spec.json costfirst)
findings.finding: On the four-phase build the inductor's worst-point loss exceeds its thermal limit at the module's airflow: -5.3 K (160 C; module model 155 C); thermal_limit_W {'PV-P75': 87.6011122553161, 'PV-P100/110': 79.50412315548192}
findings.evidence: pv_m2_margin_pvp100 -5.3 K (160 C; module model 155 C) (>= 0 K (155 C)); loss at which the hot spot reaches 155 C at the module's airflow per phase and 45 C inlet (local air 55 C ASSUMED); Rth scaled from 1.073 K/W at 150 m3/h with (mass flow)^-0.6 as sim/pv_module.py
findings.recommendation: The module derates this build (D-056; NTC trip band 146-154 C keeps the hot spot); to remove the derating: more air per phase (>= 134 m3/h), or the edgewise flat-wire option (D-048 option table, -11 W own model) once its loss is confirmed on a sample

findings.where: sim/out/magnetics/design_dab_transformer.json rev M1 vs dab_spec.json transformer I1_rms_max_A
findings.finding: The transformer's maximum current rose to 137.3 A rms (rev M1 was designed to 118.5 A): the worst corner (that current with the v2low current shape + 950 V flux) gives 189 W and a hot spot of 133 C with the DMEGC core-set loss limit (126 C with typical core loss) at 65 C coolant
findings.evidence: dab_m1_loss 189 W (<= 182 W); dab_m1_hot 133 C (<= 130 C)
findings.recommendation: The window is full (build = window): no more copper fits. Options: (a) coolant <= 62 C at the 137 A corner or derate the current above it; (b) three units in parallel; (c) settle it in the DAB cost round (rev M2) together with MG-15
